title: Orbit Bridge: Workflow Surface & Navigation Redesign for Console Dashboards and Cost Lenses
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Redesign the Console information architecture and left-rail navigation to better surface dashboards, rollout controls, and cost/billing views. Deliver high-fidelity prototypes for developer and enterprise workflows, validate with usability sessions, and produce an implementation handoff that supports progressive rollout for hosted and dedicated customers.
background: Current Console navigation mixes long lists of routes with contextual actions (rollouts, cost breakdowns, model routes). Engineers and platform teams report confusion when switching between Workspaces and when trying to find per-route cost telemetry. The current sidebar has grown organically and contains duplicated entry points for similar surfaces (e.g., 'Billing' vs 'Cost Analysis' vs route-level 'Cost'). This project aims to reduce cognitive load, speed workspace switching, and make rollout and cost surfaces discoverable without creating new navigation depth.
objectives: Consolidate cost-related surfaces under a clear taxonomy so users can find billing, cost breakdowns, and cost-optimizations within two clicks
Design a workspace switcher that is fast (keyboard + mouse), persistent across routes, and supports role-aware filters
Restructure left-rail to prioritize operational surfaces: Routes, Rollouts, Dashboards, Billing, Settings
Ensure accessibility (keyboard nav, screen reader labels) and responsive behavior for narrow viewports
Provide an implementation-ready design spec and a migration path with telemetry hooks to measure impact
proposed_changes: Introduce a compact persistent left-rail with 6 top-level zones: Workspace, Routes, Rollouts, Dashboards, Billing & Cost, Settings
Move workspace switcher to a single top-left anchor with recent/frequent workspaces and fast keyboard invocation (Ctrl/Cmd+K opens switcher pre-focused)
Add a contextual mini-toolbar under the left-rail for route-level quick-actions (canary rollback, promote, cost-preview)
Consolidate all cost-related pages under 'Billing & Cost' with a cost-lenses subnav (Per-Route, Per-Model, Time-series, Forecasts)
Expose rollout canary and A/B controls as first-class routes with an in-rail health badge showing latest SLI and rollback affordance
Provide a migration banner pattern for admin users to opt-in per-team to the new nav before org-wide switch
route_map: Proposed URL structure (conceptual): /workspace/:id -> workspace home; /workspace/:id/routes -> routes list; /workspace/:id/routes/:route_id -> route detail (tabs: Overview, Rollouts, Cost, Logs); /workspace/:id/rollouts -> rollout center; /workspace/:id/dashboards -> dashboards library; /workspace/:id/billing -> billing overview; /workspace/:id/billing/cost-lenses -> cost breakdowns
workspace_switcher_details: Top-left chip with workspace avatar + name; press Enter to open full switcher modal
Modal supports fuzzy search, pinned workspaces, recent activity stream, and role-aware filters (Admin, Viewer, Billing)
Switcher persists last-selected workspace per browser and syncs across tabs via localStorage with optimistic UI
Keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl+K to open, arrow keys to navigate, Enter to jump, / to focus search within switcher
accessibility_considerations: ARIA roles for left-rail region and each nav item; explicit aria-current for active route
Command palette and switcher must be operable entirely via keyboard and announced by screen readers
Contrast and sizing maintained for collapsed vs expanded states; hover-only affordances avoided
Announcements for workspace change ("Switched to workspace X") to reduce cognitive disorientation
acceptance_criteria: Prototype delivered in Figma with desktop responsive variants (>=1024px and 800-1024px) and a collapsed rail state
Usability test with at least 6 participants (mix of PMs, Engineers, Platform) shows median time-to-switch reduced by >=25%
Top-level nav reduced to <=6 items and validated by card-sorting session with 10 internal users
All cost surfaces reachable in <=2 clicks from left-rail or switcher
Design spec includes tokenized spacing, iconography, and CSS guidance for collapsed/expanded states
Telemetry events defined for: nav_click, workspace_switch, rollout_open, cost_page_open, switcher_search_term
Developer handoff doc and an engineering feasibility review (ENG assignee feedback) completed
prototypes: Mobile narrow viewport variants included in the Figma file
decisions: Adopt persistent left-rail rather than top nav: better for discovery of operational surfaces
Collapse-by-default for narrow screens and user preference; persistent collapse state stored per-user
Consolidate all cost pages under a single Billing & Cost entry rather than separate top-level items
Expose rollout controls as distinct routes to enable deep-linking to canary dashboards and rollbacks
open_questions: Should 'Dashboards' surface be split into Templates vs Custom dashboards or served via a single library?
How should we treat legacy deep-links that point to /billing/cost-analysis (rewrite map or compatibility shim)?
What role-scoped items should be hidden from non-admins by default vs accessible but read-only?
What analytics thresholds will trigger automatic migration recommendations for customers?
